liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Reviewer calls this version sick and enjoyed it while listening the morning after the show [9]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Reviewer notes this is a song most fans never heard Jerry play live [10]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 review): Green Onions was worked into the song, credited to Jeff [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Injury Report**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Drums**: with Joe Russo [15]
- **E. Black Muddy River**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **deadco2023-06-21.akg414** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 206 min [1]
- **deadco2023-06-21.omt8audmtrx.perez.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 191 min [2]
- **deadco2023-06-21.EJL95**: source not stated; 18 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers an audience recording over available soundboards, calling it crisp [9]
- **deadco2023-06-21.CitiFieldQueensNY**: audience recording; 17 songs; 191 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [4]
- **DeadCo2023-06-21.pasternak.MG210.flac24**: source not stated; 17 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this recording has the clearest sound among several, with little audience noise but enough for atmosphere [13]
- **DeadCo2023-06-21.pasternak.MG210.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this recording has the clearest sound among several, with little audience noise but enough for atmosphere [14]

## Around the show

- Guests: Joe Russo [1]
- The livestream had difficulties, which affected fans watching from home [8]
- A couple traveled from France to attend the Final Tour show [12]
- Taper was left of the soundboard at the pit's back rail, about 14 feet high, with a tripod [3]
- Lineup listed as Weir, Mayer, Burbridge and Hart, with Joe Russo on drums [4]
- This version appeared several days after about six other recordings, and the reviewer ranks it above them [13]
- This version appeared several days after about six other recordings, and the reviewer ranks it above them [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2023-06-21.akg414**: taped by Cam Keough; transferred by Cam Keough; source: 6 Track Matrix Source 1: AKG C414 XLII Hypercardioids-> Zoom F6(32/96) Source 2: Vanguard V1 Omni-> Zoom F6(32/96) Source 3: Audio Technica 3031 Cards-> Zoom… [1]. Also: Processed through Adobe Audition, CD Wave and THL; taped slightly left of the soundboard, 12 feet high [1]
- **deadco2023-06-21.omt8audmtrx.perez.t-flac16**: taped by David Perez; source: OMT8 AUD MTX (24/48) Channels 1|2: Studio Projects C4 (hyper) split 2'@ 45 degrees -> Naiant MidBox -> Tascam DR-680MKII Channels 3|4: Samson CO2 (supercard),… [2]. Also: Eight-channel matrix with Studio Projects, Samson, JVC and Audio Technica mics recorded to a Tascam DR-680MKII; Taped at the rear of the GA floor, 11 feet up; transfer went through Audacity and Reaper [2]
- **deadco2023-06-21.EJL95**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: AKG c414 XLII Hypercardioids PAS 4" apart > Channels 3 & 4: Audio Technica 3031 Cardioids PAS 12" apart > Channels 5 & 6: Vanguard V1… [3]. Also: The taper is described as posting his recordings to the archive right after each show, covering the final tour; Six channels from AKG C414, Audio Technica 3031 and Vanguard V1 mics; SD to WAV, Reaper, then 24-bit FLAC [3][8]
- **deadco2023-06-21.CitiFieldQueensNY**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Schoeps CCM 41V's & Schoeps CCM 41's > Lemo Cables > MixPre 6 II @ 32/48 [4]. Also: Audience recording with Schoeps CCM 41V and CCM 41 mics into a MixPre 6 II at 32/48, taped front-of-board left, 8 feet high [4]
- **DeadCo2023-06-21.pasternak.MG210.flac24**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Microtech Gefell 210's>Oade 248>Sound Devices 722 [5]
- **DeadCo2023-06-21.pasternak.MG210.flac16**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Microtech Gefell 210's>Oade 248>Sound Devices 722 [6]
